_comment: Programs that must NOT compile. Each entry pairs a file under
examples/rejected/ with the exit code and a message fragment the
diagnostic must contain, so the compiler's best errors are pinned by a
test instead of only being described in prose. These files are excluded
from the examples/ glob used by the e2e gates, which require every
example to build and run; see test/test_rejected_examples.py.

cases.why: Source recursion is banned; a self-call is rejected at the definition.
An indirect cycle is the same rule, and the diagnostic names the path.
A ref parameter can write the divisor, so the guard does not survive the call.
`new [N]T` is fail-closed until the language defines a model for it.
usize is the index type; an i32 subscript is refused, not converted.
An unknown stdlib call is rejected at the call site.
